content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.bangalore_metro_rail_corporation_limited: Post Graduate in any discipline with Human Resources (HR) as one of the optional subjects, or a Post Graduate Diploma in Human Resource Management.
Maximum 50 years (as on date of the notification)

content_sections.heading: BMRCL Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. BMRCL/HR/0007/PRJ/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download BMRCL notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Post Graduate in any discipline with Human Resources (HR) as one of the optional subjects, or a Post Graduate Diploma in Human Resource Management. Experience: Should have worked in a senior capacity (Group B) in the GoK scale of 69250 - 134200 for at least 5 years with overall minimum experience of 20 years in the field of Personnel / Administration / HR in any Government of Karnataka Department / State or Central PSUs / Large Public Limited Company. Age limit: Maximum 50 years (as on date of the notification) Other conditions: Knowledge of Kannada is essential. Candidates working in State Government / Autonomous Body / Public Sector Undertaking must produce NOC.

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for BMRCL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Internal employees (Regular/Contract/Outsource) working in BMRCL are not eligible to apply.

content_sections.heading: BMRCL General Manager (HR and Admin) Job Description
content_sections.text: Key Responsibility includes: Managing HR and Cadre – related matters, including services matters concerning various categories of employees. Engaging and procuring personal across different categories as per organizational requirement. Managing general administrative matters and overseeing procurement activities.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Tenure of contract appointment will initially be for a period of 5 (Five) years and extendable based on performance and requirement. The contract may be terminated by either side by giving 3 months’ notice or by paying contractual remuneration in lieu of notice period.

content_sections.heading: How Will BMRCL Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting of candidates Interview by a Committee constituted by the competent authority Selection will be made through interview by a Committee constituted by the competent authority.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Original passport size photograph affixed on the application form Age Proof – Copy of Birth Certificate / 10th Std. Certificate Educational Qualifications (from 10th Std. to last qualified degree) Experience Certificates (Present & Previous employments) NOC/Through Proper Channel (wherever applicable) Copy of the detailed Resume / Bio data / CV Any Other relevant certificates (if any)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BMRCL Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Visit BMRCL website www.bmrc.co.in / careers for the desired recruitment notification. Select the post applied and fill in the requisite details in the online application form. Save & print the computer generated online application form after submission. Affix the latest passport size photo and send the hard copy along with self-attested copies of supporting documents through proper channel to the specified address. Apply on or before 15 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Candidates who have been shortlisted only will be called for interview. Any canvassing by or on behalf of the candidates shall be a disqualification.
